Chief_Complaint.content: Worsening itchy, sore, red skin rash consistent with eczema flare
Chief_Complaint.source_text: Worsening itchy, sore, red skin/rash (eczema flare)

History_of_Present_Illness.content: For the past few days, skin has been sore and red on chest, hands, and arms, worst in the inner elbows
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Past few days: skin sore/red on chest, hands, arms; worst inside elbows (antecubital fossae)

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Reports very itchy and dry skin all over the body
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Very itchy and dry “all over my body”

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Current symptoms are similar to usual eczema but much worse over the past few days
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Similar to usual eczema but “way worse” past few days

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Denies weeping or oozing from the skin
Reports cracked areas of skin are present
Denies scratch marks on the skin
Has been using Diprobase and Dermal in the shower daily with no recent change
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Using Diprobase + Dermal in shower daily; no recent change

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Tried over-the-counter hydrocortisone which has not been helping
Previously tried over-the-counter antihistamines which did not work
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Antihistamines: tried OTC previously; didn’t work

Medications.content: Uses Dermal as a soap substitute
Uses blue inhaler as needed, only during asthma flares
Medications.source_text: • Blue inhaler (PRN; “only when I have a flare”)

Medications.content: Plan to start Betnovate topical steroid applied twice daily for a couple of weeks
Medications.source_text: • Start Betnovate topical steroid; apply small amount (fingertip unit guidance) BID x couple weeks

Medications.content: Plan to continue Dermal and Diprobase emollient skin care

Assessment.content: Extensive eczema flare with widespread pruritic erythematous dry rash, worst in inner elbows, without weeping
Assessment.source_text: 1. Extensive eczema flare (widespread pruritic erythematous, dry rash; inner elbows worst; no weeping)

Assessment.content: Intermittent asthma treated with blue inhaler as needed

Plan_of_Care.content: Start fexofenadine antihistamine for eczema flare
Start Betnovate topical steroid applied in small fingertip unit amounts twice daily for a couple of weeks
Plan_of_Care.source_text: • Start Betnovate topical steroid; apply small amount (fingertip unit guidance) BID x couple weeks

Plan_of_Care.content: Continue Dermal and Diprobase emollient skin care regimen
If no improvement or worsening within 2 weeks, patient should contact the service sooner
Plan_of_Care.source_text: • Safety net: if no improvement or worsening within 2 weeks, contact service sooner

Plan_of_Care.content: Seek help for any adverse or allergic reaction to treatment
Plan_of_Care.source_text: • Safety net: if no improvement or worsening within 2 weeks, contact service sooner; seek help for any adverse/allergic reaction
